title: Runaway searches stop spinning the fans

chat.text: A search an agent left running after its shell closed kept a core busy and spun the fans. Two checks are being built: a search over the whole repo or drive is refused before it starts, and a search still burning CPU after its parent is gone is ended and logged.

message.text: Landed. A search that would walk the whole disk, your home folder or the whole repo is now refused before it starts, with a message saying which folder to search instead. A leftover search still burning a core 2 minutes after its terminal closed gets ended and logged; that part starts working after the next Servex restart.
